text: Diagnosing PANS or PANDAS can be challenging. The causes of PANS are unclear and varied, and health care providers must rule out many other conditions first. Because infections, anxiety, and tic disorders are common in children, and no lab tests can confirm PANS or PANDAS, diagnosis often requires a thorough evaluation. If your child has symptoms, talk to a health care provider.
source_label: PANS and PANDAS: Questions and Answers
